limitations: Only three serial actual runs; old 276.82s reference was not rerun or controlled as a paired baseline. No stable speedup/prepare acceleration claim.
Kind payload logical shares are not mixed compressed disk shares; Canonical subtypes/fields not separately measured.
Test comparison uses original RunCursor bytes, original observe and minimal EOF prefix closure, not complete PublicRecordingReader::next_row I/O/error traversal; phase3 uses original replay/reader.
Writer 64MiB limit only covers original capacity-counted row buffer, not Arrow/compressor/reader/RSS; no directory transient peak sampled.
No old material full hashes repeated; full stored key+payload equality proved by unique phase2, limited replay digest does not prove complete generated observation payload equality.
No promise of same business error position for arbitrary byte corruption under new physical layout; original failure/EOF responsibility unchanged.
Observation persistent rows are indexes, not duplicated full L2; group widths grow with known markets, twelve-minute ratio/composition cannot budget fifteen days or continuous three days.
Candidate repeated scan/backtest reuse/full storage budget remain separate unresolved work; no account/profit/parameter or task3 completion claimed.
